title: 皐月賞の後に・賞賛の方向

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite being the daughter of a legendary Umamusume, King Halo ends up disappointing her fans at the Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But this doesn't deter her. She vows to take first place in her next race, the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night, King Halo returns to the academy to see Special Week, who professes her desire to win the Japanese Derby for her mothers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing this, King Halo becomes further fueled to gain success, and she decides to put in extra practice.
